newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bank assets hit 1.48 trillion Sfr at end-96.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bank assets hit 1.48 trillion Sfr at end-96.

text.p: The aggregate balance sheet total for banks reporting to the Swiss National Bank (SNB) stood at 1,475 billion Swiss francs at the end of 1996, up 4.3 percent compared with the previous quarter, the SNB said.
Net financial assets grew 11.2 percent to 235.7 billion, while credits rose 2.2 percent to 758.8 billion, the SNB said in an advance summary of its monthly report for February.

Customer deposits rose 3.3 percent in the quarter to 774.2 billion at year-end. Funds in trusts administered by the banks rose 8.6 percent to 303.7 billion, the highest level since mid-1993. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
